root_cause.description: The controlled primitive-color fixture had been scored with the Stage5B procedural-rendered learned model instead of the matching Stage5A synthetic color-prototype model.

frozen_replay.dataset: 30 frames and 76 independently labelled instances from the same sealed MCAP

offline_policy_replay.withdrawn_claim: Stage5A policy 0/0/76 remains withdrawn; the retained baseline policy replay is separately recomputed as 0/0/76.

decision.reason: The GPU candidate improves controlled raw replay from 33/50/43 to 41/0/35 and offline policy replay from 0/0/76 to 33/0/43, with macro P/R 0.8/0.4325 and zero metal-can policy recall. It remains an offline controlled-domain candidate, not official R01. Engineering recognition remains FAIL and the official >=95 percent definition/result remains NOT_MEASURED.

limitations: Offline replay of the same frozen MCAP only; Gazebo, ROS, localization, and board were not rerun.
Highly correlated static fixture, not an independent scene population or public blind set.
Do not tune the policy threshold on this holdout; the retained context replay is diagnostic only.
The candidate does not support a 95 percent claim and competition_perception_pass remains false.
Engineering recognition quality remains FAIL; the official >=95 percent result remains NOT_MEASURED.
